description.name: Entry
description.text: Ten single attacks (1.70 each), grants [Attach Water], [Awash Follow-Up] and [Surging Wave 0] to the user

description.name: Attach Water
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Water damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Water resistance +20%

description.name: Awash Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Awash after using a Water ability

description.name: Surging Wave 0
description.text: Grants [Surging Wave 1] after using a Water ability, removed if the character hasn't [Awash Follow-Up]
